cases.feedback: States the main cause is Earth's changing distance from the Sun (elliptical orbit); this is the false belief the card targets. Treats axial tilt as only a minor factor instead of the cause. Does not explain that each hemisphere gets more direct sunlight when it leans toward the Sun. Claims the whole planet shares one season at a time; the hemispheres have opposite seasons. Tilt is mentioned, but you call it minor and make distance the main cause, which is the misconception. Seasons come from the axial tilt: the hemisphere leaning toward the Sun gets more direct sunlight. Both hemispheres don't share a season, since when it's summer in the north it's winter in the south.
